transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what's been troubling you lately that brought you here today?

I… I came in because my head’s been feeling foggy. At work, I can’t even keep my place in old cataloguing notes sometimes, and simple decisions feel harder than they should. Like I just… don’t know what to do next.
Have you been feeling down, hopeless, or have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy?

Yeah… I guess I have. Most days I just sit at the kitchen table and everything feels kind of… drained. Even my watercolor books, the ones I used to like looking through, they just feel heavy now. Not really enjoyable.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About… three months, I think. Most days. It started around when I began getting ready to leave the library.
Have you had any periods of feeling this way before, or is this the first time you've felt this depressed?
I’m… not really sure. I mean, I’ve had low stretches before, like anyone, but I don’t know if it was like this. I haven’t really kept track.
Can you think of a time before this current period when you felt down or hopeless nearly every day for at least two weeks?
I… I can’t really think of one clearly. Maybe I’ve had a couple rough patches, but whether it was nearly every day for two weeks… I don’t know. I didn’t pay that much attention then.
Can you recall if there was ever a time before this current period when you felt down, hopeless, or lost interest in things for a period of two weeks or more?
I honestly don’t know. I can remember being low before, but whether it went on that long or was every day… I can’t say for sure.
Can you think of any time before these last three months when you felt down or lost interest in things for two weeks or more?
I don’t really have a clear answer. Before these last few months… I might’ve had times where I felt off, but I can’t say it was two weeks or more. I just didn’t keep track.
Can you think of any time before these last three months when you felt down or lost interest in things for a full two weeks or more without relief?
I’m not sure. I don’t really remember a stretch like that clearly before these last few months. Maybe I had bad days, but a full two weeks without any letup… I can’t say.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the contrary, have you been more restless or agitated lately?
Yeah… slower, I guess. My body just feels heavy. Even walking to the corner store or sorting papers on my desk feels like it takes more effort than it should.
Have you been feeling guilty or blamed yourself for things more than usual lately?
I don’t know… not especially. I mean, I think about things I should’ve done better, but I wouldn’t say it’s been more than usual.
Have you been feeling a loss of energy or fatigue nearly every day during this current period?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I get tired, but I haven’t been keeping track of whether it’s nearly every day.
Have you been feeling a loss of energy or fatigue nearly every day during this current period?
I guess I can’t really say. I feel worn out some days, but I haven’t been paying enough attention to know if it’s nearly every day.
Can you tell me if you've been feeling a loss of energy or fatigue nearly every day during this current period?
I’m sorry, I just… I don’t really know. I’ve had tired days, sure, but I haven’t noticed whether it’s been almost every day.
Can you tell me if you’ve been feeling a loss of energy or fatigue nearly every day during this current period?
I really don’t know how to answer that. I get tired, but I haven’t noticed it closely enough to say it’s nearly every day.
Can you tell me if you’ve been feeling a loss of energy or fatigue nearly every day during this current period?
I know you’ve asked, but I still can’t really say. I haven’t been keeping track of it that closely.
Can you tell me if you’ve been feeling a loss of energy or fatigue nearly every day since this period started?
I still can’t really pin that down. I’ve felt worn out at times, but whether it’s been nearly every day since it started… I’m not sure.
Can you tell me if you’ve noticed feeling a loss of energy or fatigue almost every day since this period started?
I’m not really sure. I’ve had days where I feel tired, yeah, but I can’t honestly say I’ve noticed it almost every day.
Can you tell me if you’ve noticed feeling a loss of energy or fatigue on most days since this period started?
I don’t know… “most days” is hard for me to say. I’ve felt tired here and there, but I haven’t really been counting it like that.
Can you tell me if you’ve noticed feeling a loss of energy or fatigue on most days since this period started?
I guess I haven’t really noticed it that way. I get tired sometimes, but I can’t say it’s been most days.
